body:
> (this one with the RADV driver instead of the AMDVLK driver)

Are you sure the other logs aren't from RADV? This `GCVM_L2_PROTECTION_FAULT_STATUS` issue comes up a lot in specific games with RADV but people have reported that it doesn't happen with AMDVLK.

Related driver developer discussions. These suggest the issue is triggered by compute pipelines and some kind of memory segmentation fault between the GPU driver and the kernel.
- https://github.com/ROCm/ROCm/issues/2642
- https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/drm/amd/-/issues/2991

Related Godot issues:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/96962
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/72274

> Are you sure the other logs aren't from RADV?

Looking through my pacman logs, it seems like I did have `vulkan-radeon` a.k.a. RADV installed as well. The AMDVLK driver appears to contain some switching magic. It should select itself as the default, but I cannot say with 100% certainty that the earlier logs _were_ produced with AMDVLK.

I'll now proceed to install `amdvlk` and remove `vulkan-radeon` and report back if the crashes continue.

Using AMDVLK also causes the crash, just now:

```
Feb 03 09:42:29 craig kernel: amdgpu 0000:03:00.0: amdgpu: [gfxhub] page fault (src_id:0 ring:40 vmid:4 pasid:32781)
Feb 03 09:42:29 craig kernel: amdgpu 0000:03:00.0: amdgpu:  in process godot-mono-beta pid 424436 thread godot-mono-beta pid 424436
Feb 03 09:42:29 craig kernel: amdgpu 0000:03:00.0: amdgpu:   in page starting at address 0x0000000710bbb000 from client 0x1b (UTCL2)
Feb 03 09:42:29 craig kernel: amdgpu 0000:03:00.0: amdgpu: GCVM_L2_PROTECTION_FAULT_STATUS:0x00441051
Feb 03 09:42:29 craig kernel: amdgpu 0000:03:00.0: amdgpu:          Faulty UTCL2 client ID: TCP (0x8)
```

This also shows that 4.4-beta2 did not solve it – not that I expected it to.

You can either wait another 5 years for a solution to this long-standing problem with AMD drivers, or you can sell your AMD graphics card and buy an NVIDIA one.

https://github.com/ROCm/ROCm/issues/2642#issuecomment-3315372562

I understand your frustration and I've had the same thought more than once, but (a) it's not only an issue with recent kernels, (b) Godot is the only one that triggers it for me; other games are rock solid.
Just a heads up. It seems that AMD is discontinuing the AMDVLK open source drivers and are recommending that everyone use RADV https://github.com/GPUOpen-Drivers/AMDVLK/discussions/416

It was happening in both drivers for me, but I switched back to RADV yesterday. Maybe with all the recent turbulence in AMD drivers, this issue will magically have resolved itself. It sometimes happens multiple times a day, sometimes not at all for a week, so it might be some time until I know.

Alas, it's still happening with RADV as well, and on Godot 4.5 stable. Display freezes, then resets 10-20 seconds later to an Xorg login screen.
